Game Overview

Kitty Kuro Lab Escape is a platformer game built around help Kitty Kuro dodge dangerous syringes and evade the persistent doctor in a thrilling lab escape. Gather antidotes, collect key cards, and strategize your path to freedom. Experience a heart-pounding chase, all while dressed in whimsical costumes across mobile and PC platforms. Can you guide Kitty to safety?
